summary.text: Jessie Rodriguez is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 21, based in Oak Creek, first elected in a November 2013 special election.
She serves on the Committee on Finance and the Joint Committee on Finance.

paragraphs.text: Rodriguez was born in Puerto el Triunfo, El Salvador, on July 5, 1977, and is married.
She graduated from Alexander Hamilton High School in Milwaukee in 1996 and earned a B.A. from Marquette University in 2002.
The Legislature's page lists her as a full-time legislator and a former analyst for a supermarket company and outreach coordinator for a nonprofit.

It says she was elected to the Assembly in a November 2013 special election and has been reelected since 2014, and that she held the Majority Caucus Secretary leadership position in 2015, 2017 and 2019.
She is a member of the State Fair Park Board and the Wisconsin Center District Board.
